author: Bobby Grayson
title: Bug found on the way: killing a lock client that is linked to the fuzz driver (start_link) killed the driver ('EXIT ... killed'); a queued client is blocked in its GenServer.call and cannot be stopped, so the twin unlinks then kills. Also: elixir/src/lock.ex and bank.ex both define Client, so fuzz.exs evals lock.ex with Client renamed to LockClient (the module text is otherwise unchanged; the protocol under test is the real one).
